composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Build a small anemone-like creature from short textile bristles arranged around a round cream face. Alternate broad rust-red and straw-yellow tufts, leaving the small eyes unobstructed. Tilt the face with bright curiosity while keeping the fringe compact. Soft directional lighting reveals fibers against a deep green field, without wet skin or underwater scenery. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
